entry_rule: Official regular-session close on 2026-10-02, selected on 2026-10-03 at the owner's request. All symbols must be present. No later substitute entry date.
weight_rule: Twelve stocks, equal initial allocations, buy and hold, no rebalancing. Each benchmark starts with the same notional.
return_basis: Vendor dividend/split-adjusted daily close ratios; modeled gross total-return proxy. No tax, execution costs or FX. ETF operating expenses are reflected in fund prices.
source_claim: User-supplied screenshot of a social post; original post URL and publication time not verified. This is an editorial test of its listed stocks, not the author's actual portfolio or an endorsement by any person pictured.
revision_reason: Owner requested the previous trading day close instead of the next trading day close, before any performance was recorded.
